answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns full standing after settled work with 12 distinct counterparties, blocking sybil fakes trading only with each other. Jobs are logged at the wharf in a marble ledger, countersigned with a quill. Each counterparty counts once, so 50 sock puppets gain nothing. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 12 x 5 POA = 6,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 5 POA fee per partner and keeps rewards undiluted.
